title: Act: Add UI dependencies, Tailwind and shadcn config and cn helper
summary: Declare deps, add Tailwind/PostCSS/shadcn config, cn helper and directives
description: Add the UI stack dependencies and configuration files to game/frontend so Tailwind utilities and the shadcn cn helper work.
acceptance_criteria: styles.css starts with the three @tailwind directives
definition_of_done: Files exist and npm run build succeeds

steps.action: Add dependencies zustand, motion, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-dialog, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge and devDependencies tailwindcss@^3.4.0, postcss, autoprefixer
steps.expected: npm install in game/frontend resolves and package.json lists all packages

steps.action: Create Tailwind config with content ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme.extend empty, plugins []
steps.code: export default { content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: {} }, plugins: [] } satisfies import('tailwindcss').Config;

steps.action: Create PostCSS config enabling tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
Create shadcn components.json with style default, tailwind.config tailwind.config.ts, tailwind.css src/styles.css, aliases components 'src/components' and utils 'src/lib/utils'

steps.code: import { clsx, type ClassValue } from 'clsx'; import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'; export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)); }

steps.action: Insert @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; as the first three lines, keeping all existing rules below
steps.expected: styles.css begins with the three directives
